definition.path: URL.pathname stripped of trailing /, empty => /. method uppercased. Catalog matching precedes auth/dispatch. Slug decoded once and must pass isValidSlug with no embedded slash; malformed encoding cannot select ledger. Known catalog path/wrong method => 405; unknown /api path => 404. Imperative regex may further constrain resource path. Query get uses first value unless getAll validation appears in operation.
definition.authentication: Better Auth: public.read/public.invitation.claim bypass session lookup; other routes authenticate session/service principal once. Invalid/absent/stale database session => 401 missing or invalid credentials. Local authRequired=false is localhost-trusted; true requires configured Bearer secret on ALL routes including public. Authorization checks workspace/company membership before handler opens ledger; denied = 401 not 403, authorization audit appended without existence leak.
definition.originAndFreshness: Hosted unsafe requests require trusted Origin. High-risk permission unsafe Better Auth requests require server-clock session age 0..600000ms inclusive, else 401 unauthorized with subcode SESSION_REAUTH_REQUIRED. Service principals do not use browser session freshness gate. Company mutation pipeline additionally enforces local Host/origin/content-type, body size/JSON object, actor, confirm when configured, backup lock, revocation recheck and optional idempotency.
definition.cors: No general Access-Control-Allow-Origin or successful generic OPTIONS/preflight response in TS app/router. OPTIONS on catalog path is wrong-method 405 (after authentication). Mutation application/json/Origin enforcement is CSRF protection, not a CORS grant.
definition.transportExclusions: HTTP operation: no CLI invocation/argv/stdout or MCP request/result framing. Equivalent core CLI/MCP may exist but this row does not assert their wire availability. /api/auth/* except sign-up is exclusively delegated to configured Better Auth; sign-up blocked 404. Non-api GET/HEAD may serve static SPA fallback; API errors remain JSON.

export function intercompanyDispositionStatus(db:Database,workspace:string,id:string,asOf=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)){const current=state(db,text(id,"disposition id",80));if(!current)return null;const exceptions:any[]=[];for(const link of current.links){try{const actual=snapshot(workspace,link.company_slug,link.journal_entry_id);if(actual.entry.entry_hash!==link.journal_entry_hash||actual.ledgerHeadHash!==link.ledger_head_hash)exceptions.push({kind:"stale_or_reversed_journal",side:link.side,waivable:false});else assertLinkMatches(current,link.side,actual);}catch(error){exceptions.push({kind:"stale_or_reversed_journal",side:link.side,waivable:false});}}
if(current.status==="partly_posted")exceptions.push({kind:"one_sided_posting",side:current.links[0]?.side,waivable:false});if(current.status!=="settled"&&current.disposition.settlementDueDate&&current.disposition.settlementDueDate<date(asOf,"asOf"))exceptions.push({kind:"overdue_settlement",dueDate:current.disposition.settlementDueDate,waivable:false});return {...current,exceptions,balanced:current.status==="posted"&&exceptions.length===0,scope:"intercompany-disposition-status" as const};}

coreContracts.resultType: any
coreContracts.implementation: export function proposeIntercompanyDisposition(db:Database,input:unknown,audit:{actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){const value=parse(input);requireRecordAndParties(db,value);return db.transaction(()=>{const exists=state(db,value.dispositionId);const payload=canonical(value);if(exists){if(exists.payloadHash===sha(payload)&&exists.status==="proposed")return exists;throw new Error("disposition id already exists with a different or completed lifecycle");}db.query("INSERT INTO rm_intercompany_dispositions(disposition_id,canonical_payload,payload_hash,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?)").run(value.dispositionId,payload,sha(payload),new Date().toISOString());event(db,value.dispositionId,"proposed",value,audit.actor,audit.principal);return state(db,value.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

coreContracts.resultType: any
coreContracts.implementation: export function approveIntercompanyDisposition(db:Database,id:string,payloadHash:string,audit:{actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){return db.transaction(()=>{const current=state(db,text(id,"disposition id",80));if(!current||current.payloadHash!==payloadHash)throw new Error("exact proposed disposition was not found");if(current.status==="approved"||current.status==="partly_posted"||current.status==="posted")return current;if(current.status!=="proposed")throw new Error("exact proposed disposition was not found");const proposer=current.events[0];if(proposer.principal_kind===audit.principal.kind&&proposer.principal_id===audit.principal.id)throw new Error("disposition approval requires a distinct stable principal");event(db,id,"approved",{payloadHash},audit.actor,audit.principal);return state(db,id)!;}).immediate();}

coreContracts.resultType: any
coreContracts.implementation: export function linkIntercompanyDispositionJournal(db:Database,workspace:string,input:{dispositionId:string;payloadHash:string;side:DispositionSide;journalEntryId:number;expectedLedgerHeadHash:string|null;actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){return db.transaction(()=>{const current=state(db,text(input.dispositionId,"disposition id",80));if(!current||current.status!=="approved"&&current.status!=="partly_posted")throw new Error("only approved dispositions can link journals");if(current.payloadHash!==input.payloadHash)throw new Error("exact disposition hash is required");if(current.links.some((link:any)=>link.side===input.side)){const old=current.links.find((link:any)=>link.side===input.side)!;if(old.journal_entry_id===input.journalEntryId){assertCurrentLinks(workspace,current);return current;}throw new Error("disposition side already has an immutable journal link");}assertCurrentLinks(workspace,current);const expected=current.disposition[input.side];const actual=snapshot(workspace,expected.companySlug,input.journalEntryId);if(actual.ledgerHeadHash!==input.expectedLedgerHeadHash)throw new Error("ledger head changed; refresh before linking");assertLinkMatches(current,input.side,actual);db.query("INSERT INTO rm_intercompany_disposition_journal_links(disposition_id,side,company_slug,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,journal_entry_hash,ledger_head_hash,linked_at,actor,principal_kind,principal_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(input.dispositionId,input.side,expected.companySlug,input.journalEntryId,actual.entry.entry_no,actual.entry.entry_hash,actual.ledgerHeadHash,new Date().toISOString(),text(input.actor,"actor",160),input.principal.kind,text(input.principal.id,"principal id",160));lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"exception",{kind:"one_sided_posting",side:input.side,payloadHash:input.payloadHash},input.actor,input.principal);if(current.links.length===1)lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"exception_resolved",{kind:"one_sided_posting",payloadHash:input.payloadHash},input.actor,input.principal);return state(db,input.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

coreContracts.resultType: any
coreContracts.implementation: export function settleIntercompanyDisposition(db:Database,workspace:string,input:{dispositionId:string;payloadHash:string;settlementEvidenceRecordIds:string[];actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){return db.transaction(()=>{const current=state(db,text(input.dispositionId,"disposition id",80));if(!current||current.payloadHash!==input.payloadHash)throw new Error("exact fully posted disposition is required before settlement");if(current.status==="settled")return current;if(current.status!=="posted")throw new Error("exact fully posted disposition is required before settlement");if(!Array.isArray(input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds)||input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds.length<1)throw new Error("settlement requires source-linked evidence");for(const id of input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds)if(!inspectCorporateRecord(db,text(id,"settlement evidence",160)))throw new Error("settlement corporate evidence does not exist");assertCurrentLinks(workspace,current);lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"settled",{payloadHash:input.payloadHash,settlementEvidenceRecordIds:[...new Set(input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds)].sort()},input.actor,input.principal);return state(db,input.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

coreContracts.implementation: export function supersedeIntercompanyDisposition(db:Database,input:{dispositionId:string;payloadHash:string;replacementDispositionId:string;reason:string;actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){return db.transaction(()=>{const current=state(db,text(input.dispositionId,"disposition id",80));if(!current||current.payloadHash!==input.payloadHash||["settled","superseded"].includes(current.status))throw new Error("active exact disposition is required for supersession");const replacement=text(input.replacementDispositionId,"replacement disposition id",80);if(replacement===input.dispositionId||!state(db,replacement))throw new Error("supersession requires a distinct existing replacement disposition");lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"superseded",{payloadHash:input.payloadHash,replacementDispositionId:replacement,reason:text(input.reason,"supersession reason",1000)},input.actor,input.principal);return state(db,input.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

coreContracts.implementation: export function reopenIntercompanyDisposition(db:Database,workspace:string,input:{dispositionId:string;payloadHash:string;reason:string;actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){return db.transaction(()=>{const current=state(db,text(input.dispositionId,"disposition id",80));if(!current||!["settled","superseded"].includes(current.status)||current.payloadHash!==input.payloadHash)throw new Error("only exact settled or superseded dispositions can be reopened");assertCurrentLinks(workspace,current);lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"reopened",{payloadHash:input.payloadHash,reason:text(input.reason,"reopen reason",1000)},input.actor,input.principal);return state(db,input.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

coreContracts.implementation: export function approvePartyMerge(db: Database, input:{ fromPartyId:string; proposalHash:string; actor:string; observedAt?:string }) { const from=inspectParty(db,input.fromPartyId); if(!from) throw new Error("party not found"); const proposal=db.query("SELECT canonical_payload FROM rm_party_events WHERE party_id=? AND event_type='proposed_merge' AND payload_hash=?").get(input.fromPartyId,input.proposalHash) as {canonical_payload:string}|null; if(!proposal) throw new Error("exact merge proposal not found"); const payload=JSON.parse(proposal.canonical_payload); event(db,input.fromPartyId,"approved_merge",from.kind,payload,input.actor,input.observedAt); event(db,input.fromPartyId,"superseded",from.kind,payload,input.actor,input.observedAt); return inspectParty(db,input.fromPartyId)!; }

definition.authentication: Better Auth: public.read/public.invitation.claim bypass session lookup; other routes authenticate session/service principal once. definition.originAndFreshness: Hosted unsafe requests require trusted Origin. definition.path: URL.pathname stripped of trailing /, empty => /. method uppercased. Catalog matching precedes auth/dispatch. Slug decoded once and must pass isValidSlug with no embedded slash; malformed encoding cannot select ledger. Known catalog path/wrong method => 405; unknown /api path => 404. Imperative regex may further constrain resource path. Query get uses first value unless getAll validation appears in operation.
definition.authentication: Better Auth: public.read/public.invitation.claim bypass session lookup; other routes authenticate session/service principal once. Invalid/absent/stale database session => 401 missing or invalid credentials. Local authRequired=false is localhost-trusted; true requires configured Bearer secret on ALL routes including public. Authorization checks workspace/company membership before handler opens ledger; denied = 401 not 403, authorization audit appended without existence leak.
definition.originAndFreshness: Hosted unsafe requests require trusted Origin. High-risk permission unsafe Better Auth requests require server-clock session age 0..600000ms inclusive, else 401 unauthorized with subcode SESSION_REAUTH_REQUIRED. Service principals do not use browser session freshness gate. Company mutation pipeline additionally enforces local Host/origin/content-type, body size/JSON object, actor, confirm when configured, backup lock, revocation recheck and optional idempotency.
definition.cors: No general Access-Control-Allow-Origin or successful generic OPTIONS/preflight response in TS app/router. OPTIONS on catalog path is wrong-method 405 (after authentication). Mutation application/json/Origin enforcement is CSRF protection, not a CORS grant.
definition.transportExclusions: HTTP operation: no CLI invocation/argv/stdout or MCP request/result framing. coreContracts.implementation: export function listDocumentPartyLinks(ledger:Database, input:{status?:"linked"|"unlinked"|DocumentResolutionState;limit?:number}={}) { const linked="EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM current_document_party_links l WHERE l.document_id=d.id)"; const internal="EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM current_document_party_resolution_events r WHERE r.document_id=d.id)"; const state=`CASE WHEN ${internal} THEN 'internal_no_external_party' WHEN ${linked} THEN 'resolved' ELSE 'unresolved' END`; const wanted=input.status==="linked"?"resolved":input.status==="unlinked"?"unresolved":input.status; const where=wanted?`WHERE ${state}=?`:""; return ledger.query(`SELECT d.id,d.document_no,d.sha256_hash, ${linked} AS linked, ${state} AS resolution_state FROM documents d ${where} ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT ?`).all(...(wanted?[wanted,Math.min(Math.max(input.limit??100,1),100)]:[Math.min(Math.max(input.limit??100,1),100)])); }

definition.authentication: Better Auth: public.read/public.invitation.claim bypass session lookup; other routes authenticate session/service principal once. definition.path: URL.pathname stripped of trailing /, empty => /. method uppercased. Catalog matching precedes auth/dispatch. Slug decoded once and must pass isValidSlug with no embedded slash; malformed encoding cannot select ledger. Known catalog path/wrong method => 405; unknown /api path => 404. definition.authentication: Better Auth: public.read/public.invitation.claim bypass session lookup; other routes authenticate session/service principal once. Invalid/absent/stale database session => 401 missing or invalid credentials. Local authRequired=false is localhost-trusted; true requires configured Bearer secret on ALL routes including public. Authorization checks workspace/company membership before handler opens ledger; denied = 401 not 403, authorization audit appended without existence leak.
definition.originAndFreshness: Hosted unsafe requests require trusted Origin. High-risk permission unsafe Better Auth requests require server-clock session age 0..600000ms inclusive, else 401 unauthorized with subcode SESSION_REAUTH_REQUIRED. Service principals do not use browser session freshness gate. Company mutation pipeline additionally enforces local Host/origin/content-type, body size/JSON object, actor, confirm when configured, backup lock, revocation recheck and optional idempotency.
definition.cors: No general Access-Control-Allow-Origin or successful generic OPTIONS/preflight response in TS app/router. OPTIONS on catalog path is wrong-method 405 (after authentication). Mutation application/json/Origin enforcement is CSRF protection, not a CORS grant.
definition.transportExclusions: HTTP operation: no CLI invocation/argv/stdout or MCP request/result framing. definition.path: URL.pathname stripped of trailing /, empty => /. method uppercased. Catalog matching precedes auth/dispatch. definition.authentication: Better Auth: public.read/public.invitation.claim bypass session lookup; other routes authenticate session/service principal once. Invalid/absent/stale database session => 401 missing or invalid credentials. Local authRequired=false is localhost-trusted; true requires configured Bearer secret on ALL routes including public. Authorization checks workspace/company membership before handler opens ledger; denied = 401 not 403, authorization audit appended without existence leak.
definition.originAndFreshness: Hosted unsafe requests require trusted Origin. High-risk permission unsafe Better Auth requests require server-clock session age 0..600000ms inclusive, else 401 unauthorized with subcode SESSION_REAUTH_REQUIRED. Service principals do not use browser session freshness gate. Company mutation pipeline additionally enforces local Host/origin/content-type, body size/JSON object, actor, confirm when configured, backup lock, revocation recheck and optional idempotency.
definition.cors: No general Access-Control-Allow-Origin or successful generic OPTIONS/preflight response in TS app/router. OPTIONS on catalog path is wrong-method 405 (after authentication). Mutation application/json/Origin enforcement is CSRF protection, not a CORS grant.
definition.transportExclusions: HTTP operation: no CLI invocation/argv/stdout or MCP request/result framing. definition.authentication: Better Auth: public.read/public.invitation.claim bypass session lookup; other routes authenticate session/service principal once. definition.originAndFreshness: Hosted unsafe requests require trusted Origin. Service principals do not use browser session freshness gate. Company mutation pipeline additionally enforces local Host/origin/content-type, body size/JSON object, actor, confirm when configured, backup lock, revocation recheck and optional idempotency.
definition.cors: No general Access-Control-Allow-Origin or successful generic OPTIONS/preflight response in TS app/router. OPTIONS on catalog path is wrong-method 405 (after authentication). Mutation application/json/Origin enforcement is CSRF protection, not a CORS grant.

coreContracts.implementation: export function approveBookkeepingBatchPlan(db: Database, input: BatchActor & { principal?: BatchPrincipal; runId: number; planHash: string }) { if (!validActor(input.actor)) throw new Error("actor is required"); const principal=batchPrincipal(db,input); return db.transaction(() => { const revision = db.query("SELECT id,planner_kind,planner_subject_id FROM bookkeeping_batch_revisions WHERE run_id=? AND revision_hash=?").get(input.runId,input.planHash) as {id:number;planner_kind:BatchPrincipal['kind'];planner_subject_id:string}|null; if (!revision) throw new Error("exact pending plan was not found"); if (revision.planner_kind===principal.kind && revision.planner_subject_id===principal.subjectId) throw new Error("SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN"); const existing=db.query("SELECT 1 FROM bookkeeping_batch_revision_approvals WHERE revision_id=?").get(revision.id); if (!existing) { db.query("INSERT INTO bookkeeping_batch_revision_approvals(revision_id,principal_kind,principal_subject_id,actor,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)").run(revision.id,principal.kind,principal.subjectId,input.actor,new Date().toISOString()); event(db,input.runId,"approved",input.planHash,input.actor,{principal:{kind:principal.kind,subjectId:principal.subjectId}}); } return { ok: true as const }; }).immediate(); }

definition.path: URL.pathname stripped of trailing /, empty => /. method uppercased. Catalog matching precedes auth/dispatch. Slug decoded once and must pass isValidSlug with no embedded slash; malformed encoding cannot select ledger. Known catalog path/wrong method => 405; unknown /api path => 404. Imperative regex may further constrain resource path. Query get uses first value unless getAll validation appears in operation.
definition.authentication: Better Auth: public.read/public.invitation.claim bypass session lookup; other routes authenticate session/service principal once. Invalid/absent/stale database session => 401 missing or invalid credentials. Local authRequired=false is localhost-trusted; true requires configured Bearer secret on ALL routes including public. Authorization checks workspace/company membership before handler opens ledger; denied = 401 not 403, authorization audit appended without existence leak.
definition.originAndFreshness: Hosted unsafe requests require trusted Origin. High-risk permission unsafe Better Auth requests require server-clock session age 0..600000ms inclusive, else 401 unauthorized with subcode SESSION_REAUTH_REQUIRED. Service principals do not use browser session freshness gate. Company mutation pipeline additionally enforces local Host/origin/content-type, body size/JSON object, actor, confirm when configured, backup lock, revocation recheck and optional idempotency.
definition.cors: No general Access-Control-Allow-Origin or successful generic OPTIONS/preflight response in TS app/router. OPTIONS on catalog path is wrong-method 405 (after authentication). Mutation application/json/Origin enforcement is CSRF protection, not a CORS grant.
definition.transportExclusions: HTTP operation: no CLI invocation/argv/stdout or MCP request/result framing. Equivalent core CLI/MCP may exist but this row does not assert their wire availability. /api/auth/* except sign-up is exclusively delegated to configured Better Auth; sign-up blocked 404. Non-api GET/HEAD may serve static SPA fallback; API errors remain JSON.

definition.authentication: Better Auth: public.read/public.invitation.claim bypass session lookup; other routes authenticate session/service principal once. RETURNING id,created_at").get(p.id,input.packet.hash,actor,principalJson(input.reviewerPrincipal)) as {id:number;created_at:string};return{id:row.id,packet:input.packet,reviewerActor:actor,reviewerPrincipal:input.reviewerPrincipal??null,createdAt:row.created_at}; }

coreContracts.implementation: export function listSupplierCommitmentOccurrenceMatches(db:Database,commitmentId?:string){const rows=(commitmentId?db.query("SELECT canonical_payload,payload_hash,actor,principal,created_at FROM supplier_commitment_occurrence_matches WHERE commitment_id=? ORDER BY occurrence_date,id").all(commitmentId):db.query("SELECT canonical_payload,payload_hash,actor,principal,created_at FROM supplier_commitment_occurrence_matches ORDER BY commitment_id,occurrence_date,id").all()) as any[];return rows.map(row=>({...JSON.parse(row.canonical_payload),payloadHash:row.payload_hash,actor:row.actor,principal:row.principal,createdAt:row.created_at}));}

coreContracts.implementation: export function supplierCommitmentAlerts(db:Database,asOf:string){if(!isValidIsoDate(asOf))return [];const end=addDays(asOf,30);const alerts:any[]=[];for(const row of listSupplierCommitments(db)){const p=JSON.parse(row.payload_json) as CommitmentProposal;for(const [kind,date] of [["notice",p.noticeDate],["renewal",p.renewalDate]] as const)if(date&&date>=asOf&&date<=end)alerts.push({commitmentId:row.commitment_id,kind,date,severity:date===asOf?"due":"upcoming"});}return alerts.sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date)||a.commitmentId.localeCompare(b.commitmentId));}

definition.wire: Browser renders DOM, not API JSON; each serverRequests adapter describes its independent API wire. Page mounted does not imply data loaded or a business mutation succeeded.

definition.gate: App health profile must be local/local-container/hosted or startup alert; Rust setupRequired shows setup view. Hosted: session, emailVerified, twoFactorEnabled and context required; /invite bypasses normal session gate. Local bypasses AuthGate checks. CompanyRouteGate uses permission below, resets component key id:slug:documentId:year. useCapabilities checks hosted company role through exact ROUTE_PERMISSION_POLICY; local returns true unless transfer read-only blocks writes. Navigation visibility is not server authorization. Static routes: /cfo hosted only; /adgang and /koncernstruktur hosted+workspace_owner; /companies/new local or workspace_owner else explicit denial; /flytning route registered for all but view requires native Rust transfer enabled and owner actions; top-nav link additionally rust+canManageWorkspace. Recovery routes apply when no hosted session; wildcard LoginView in recovery, NotFound in normal cockpit.
definition.clientFailure: HTTP401 dispatches rentemester:auth-expired; API errors display errors[0] or fallback. Network/write response loss is unknown outcome: message instructs checking status, not retry as safe. Abort propagates and must not expire newer auth state. Workspace read-only rejects ordinary client writes423 workspace_not_active before fetch.

oracle.expectation: Opening /lovgrundlag selects RulesView only after the recorded health/auth/permission gates; requests and body shaping must match the listed adapters, and actions cannot be inferred from navigation visibility.

negativeCase.scenario: Hosted principal opens /lovgrundlag without session, or with role lacking workspace route condition.
negativeCase.expectation: Missing hosted session renders recovery/login (except invite); unverified email renders verification and missing MFA renders enrollment. A company permission denial renders "Din adgang giver ikke rettighed til denne side. Vælg en anden side i menuen." rather than mounting the gated child; static routes follow their explicit conditions/wildcard.
